AfterQuery

Finance Expert

Posted 2026-10-22
View application options
Work Type
Remote
Location
United States
Compensation
$100 - $200/hr

About this opportunity

Overview

AfterQuery is building a standing bench of finance experts to create and review real-world finance scenarios for leading AI labs. The work focuses on practitioner judgment applied to everyday finance problems, including scenario writing, workflow review, and evaluating how AI models handle finance tasks.

This is a fully remote contract opportunity with flexible scheduling. There is no cap on volume, and task criteria plus support are provided in the project chat after onboarding.

What You'll Do

  • Write realistic finance scenarios and workflows based on your own professional practice.
  • Review AI-generated responses for accuracy, reasoning quality, and alignment with real-world finance practice.
  • Identify subtle issues such as incorrect calculations, flawed assumptions, or improper guidance.
  • Assess how AI models handle finance problems and mark where their reasoning breaks down.

Who They're Looking For

  • Professionals with 4+ years of hands-on experience in finance or accounting.
  • Candidates with a completed bachelor’s degree or higher.
  • Applicants authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.
  • Strong written English skills and the ability to explain reasoning clearly in writing.

Finance Backgrounds Included

  • Financial advisors, wealth managers, and paraplanners.
  • CPAs, tax managers, tax preparers, and enrolled agents.
  • Retirement and estate planning specialists.
  • Corporate finance, FP&A, and controller roles.
  • Consumer banking, lending, and credit professionals.
  • Insurance and annuities specialists.

Compensation

Pay ranges from $100 to $200 per hour depending on specialization and experience.

Additional Information

  • Ongoing project with continuing volume, rather than a one-off engagement.
  • Task criteria and support are shared in the project chat after onboarding.

Skills & expertise

Financial Analysis Accounting Finance Scenario Writing AI Response Evaluation Reasoning Assessment Compliance Review Written Communication
